record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add a fixed prefix-maturity input feature by multiplying each real history embedding by 1+0.05*min(log2(1+k)/4,1), where k counts observed real interactions through that position within the retained prefix. This mildly distinguishes sparse from established context without repeat-count or popularity features. Keep padding zero, candidate embeddings, learned embedding design, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer fixed. Reproduce the causal feature in the predictor writer.
